parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description: The domain name of the website that you want to query.

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: An array that consists of the IDs of instances to query.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: QueryDomainPattern
parameters.description:
The match mode. Valid values:

*   **fuzzy**: fuzzy match. This is the default value.
*   **exact**: exact match.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-domain-resource --domain www.example.com --query-domain-pattern fuzzy --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --instance-ids ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
